toolchain.proof: Pinned native CCS P7U R1/R2 builds and independent source/ELF/HEX audits; exact final candidate results remain attached to PR #82.

features.name: ZNP SYS_VERSION 9-byte ZStack3x0 product/revision
features.acceptance: Pin all nine bytes and distinguish P7 revision; Herdsman decoder accepts exact 9-byte payload.
features.decision: Retain TI ZNP version ABI; exact fitted-unit SYS_VERSION and host decoding remain acceptance, not an invented P7 product revision.

features.name: Extended NV/key management ZNP options and multicast behavior
features.acceptance: Compare *effective* compiler flags and ZNP command behavior; no inferred compatibility.
features.decision: Enabled ZNP/NV/AF command paths have source bounds and actual-body tests; extended host restore and multicast semantics need end-to-end proof.

features.name: Trust Center 192, NWK list 96, address manager 298, bindings 4
features.acceptance: Audit generated constants, actual live NV driver fill/compaction, 192 keys; 298 is derived, not physical proof.
features.decision: TC 192 / children 96 / addresses 298 / bindings 4 are configured. Synthetic representative NV population is not 192 real security relationships.

features.name: Route 128, source-route 128, neighbor 64, RREQ 16, hops 16, conflicts 8
features.acceptance: Assert actual imported defines and generated headers; quantify memory and runtime occupancy.
features.decision: Retain routes 128/RREQ 16; fix source-route cache 192 and neighbors 64. Keep inherited 12-relay and 3-conflict limits; historical 16/8 targets are deferred until observed paths or churn justify them. Runtime concentrator and delivery require hardware evidence.

features.name: NWK 24 buffers, waiting16 scheduled8 confirmed8
features.acceptance: Assert exactly four modified constants, real allocator use and no saturation regression.
features.decision: Retain TI NWK buffers 8/5/5/12 for first R2. Numeric 16/8/8/24 target is deferred until measured queue pressure and heap evidence justify the extra dynamically allocated messages.

features.name: OSAL 32 KiB explicit P10 heap with 6KiB previous failure
features.acceptance: Decode P7 HEAPMGR_CONFIG=0x80 / HEAPMGR_SIZE=0; compare linked symbol, free/largest block and stack budget.
features.decision: Use P7 automatic heap rather than P10 fixed 32 KiB. Linked static free region is measured; it is not current free heap or fragmentation.

features.name: Synchronous NIB NV commit before coordinator state9
features.acceptance: Verify durable NIB/status propagation before state9; examine blocking and R10 no-destructive-startup guard.
features.decision: Durable NIB-before-ready and non-destructive restore guards are implemented and host-fault-tested.

features.name: UART physical TX_DONE separate from FIFO/write-callback acceptance
features.acceptance: Audit CC26x2 UART2 event support, owner-free lifecycle, callback order, no accepted-frame retransmit.
features.decision: UART2 physical-idle event is distinguished from accepted/FIFO-loaded writes; source callbacks and ownership are tested.

features.name: UART_ISR_BUF_SIZE 128 and NPI_TL_BUF_SIZE 1080
features.acceptance: Prove RAM/stack headroom and packet-burst behavior; do not copy values without memory evidence.
features.decision: Keep pinned UART ISR 32 / TL 270 buffers; historical 128/1080 increase is not implemented. MT framing and bounded queue/RX recovery replace assumptions that larger buffers alone fix transport.

features.name: NPI/MT allocation ownership fixes for partial allocation and rejected enqueue
features.acceptance: Compile actual patched C bodies; zero leak/double-free across 512 injected cycles.
features.decision: Actual source allocation/enqueue/rejected-submit ownership repairs are composed and fault tested.

features.name: Only immediate synchronous UART rejection retries, per-frame max 3 / 50ms
features.acceptance: Inject rejected versus accepted/ambiguous writes, bounded timer, non-spin and ownership.
features.decision: At most three attempts in a 50 ms tick-domain budget; only proven pre-DMA rejection retries, accepted/ambiguous writes never retransmit. Missing callback latches bounded fault.

features.name: SRSP-first dual FIFO with AREQ fairness 4:1 and fallback
features.acceptance: Preserve ordering, ensure pending AREQ is serviced after four accepted SRSPs; failure fallback bounded.
features.decision: Bounded dual FIFO with 4:1 submitted-attempt fairness is implemented. Allocating SRSP can still fail; no allocation-free response is claimed.

features.name: Read-only MT SYS 0xF0 v2 diagnostics, 25 u32 counters + flags
features.acceptance: Exact 102-byte versioned response, zero-length query, opcode-collision audit, no secrets/side effects.
features.decision: P7 versioned request 1 snapshot and request 2 health replace exact P10 102-byte v2 ABI. F0 endpoint is enabled by G6; legacy wire ABI remains intentionally unsupported.

features.name: AF request/status/CCA and source-route counters
features.acceptance: 8 counters; 0x11/0x10/0x13/0xE1 stages classified without claiming root cause.
features.decision: Health adds AF confirmation success/no-route/CCA/noACK/other counters. They classify returned status, not closed-stack root cause, route-cache occupancy or physical delivery.

features.name: NPI RX overflow recover/resync, not infinite trap
features.acceptance: Discard invalid batch, free partial buffer once, reset SOP/length/FCS and pass next clean frame.
features.decision: Overflow recovery drops invalid buffered bytes and resets partial parser ownership; next clean MT frame can proceed.

features.name: Strict Intel HEX, P10 NV/CCFG image/erase audit
features.acceptance: Build P7 8KiB-sector geometrical audit; protect last CCFG sector, reject bank erase and NV overlap.
features.decision: P7-native strict HEX/sector writer and matching stock cleanup protect CCFG/NV; erase envelope changes require joint plan/rollback revalidation.

features.name: Pinned TI source, real CCS 12.8, native fault tests and evidence
features.acceptance: P7 independent real CCS build, immutable source allowlist, exact SHA, test and artifact proofs.
features.decision: Pinned genuine native compiler, source allowlists, binary audits and original-code negative controls are required for each changed candidate.

features.name: R6 NV budget and actual driver population/compaction tests
features.acceptance: Port actual-driver NV test methodology to P7 8KiB sectors, not R6 wrong P10 5-page layout.
features.decision: Complete pinned NVOCMP/CRC driver tested for NV2/NV5 normal/compaction/reopen and injected failures; representative population is not a live network.

features.name: R7 15 x 2KiB vendor layout correction (P10)
features.acceptance: Do not reuse physical coordinates; derive P7-native capacity/sector policy and migration.
features.decision: P7 uses 5 x 8 KiB at 0xA4000-0xAE000, never P10 coordinates. Deliberate backup-bound preparation is separate from app writer.

features.name: R8 interrupted-compaction recovery under power loss
features.acceptance: Test actual P7 NVOCMP behavior and interrupted writes; patch only after exact source review.
features.decision: Host NOR fault injection and reopen are implemented; arbitrary silicon power interruption and wear are not physically tested.

features.name: R9 duplicate record CRC/length/payload integrity and write/readback reopen
features.acceptance: Keep valid copy under torn compaction; hash/write/readback/reopen failures must fail.
features.decision: Actual driver length/CRC/readback/reopen and preservation behavior are tested; real power-cut/torn-program acceptance remains.

features.name: R10 refuse destructive startup on incompatible/ambiguous nonblank NV
features.acceptance: Preserve NV state; fail closed without silent wipe/reformat; verify allowed clean boot.
features.decision: Unsupported/ambiguous nonblank NV startup holds rather than silently formatting; existing network marker and keys are preserved.

features.name: R10 fatal initialization return-code gates + reject witness
features.acceptance: Reject failed init; do not hide failure behind state9, reject diagnostic must be bounded/non-secret.
features.decision: Checked startup/persistence results feed sticky hold before unsafe radio transmission. Bounded numeric witness exists; no automatic reset.

features.name: Legacy T832D2 DEBUG framed telemetry schema2 (events1..50)
features.acceptance: Maintain exact DEBUG framing, 20B record groups, strict decoder; not a substitute for SYS F0.
features.decision: Legacy T832D2 DEBUG framing/events 1-50 are not ported. P7 bounded query/snapshot uses its own explicitly versioned ABI without unsolicited export.

features.name: R11 operation/site-aware first NV failure: event 51
features.acceptance: Coherent first failure, explicit init/compact phase, strict event51 decoder and negative tests.
features.decision: Numeric first-failure/current-boot evidence replaces event 51; exact P10 operation/site coverage is not equivalent and unavailable vendor-library failures cannot be attributed.

features.name: R11 eight restored-startup POD sites: event 52
features.acceptance: Port 8 entry/exit/confirm sites in P7 ZStack call graph; SRAM not reset-retentive.
features.decision: P7 startup/NV/device-state hooks record source-visible sites; all eight P10 POD/event 52 semantics are not ported or claimed.

features.name: R11 runtime deltas/ages: event53; exporter fairness/backpressure
features.acceptance: Atomic snapshots, 30/60-second rates, legacy fair export, failure and saturation semantics.
features.decision: Host compares bounded snapshots/progress in one transport session. No unsolicited 30/60-second legacy exporter or previous-boot continuity is claimed.

features.name: R11 deterministic bounded host decoder, adversarial telemetry tests
features.acceptance: Offline C-to-Herdsman-to-decoder chain; reject torn, bad version, incomplete group.
features.decision: Strict P7 CRC/version/length decoder and C-to-decoder vectors replace legacy T832D2 chain; named Herdsman commands need owner adapter.

features.name: R11/R10 task/UART/NWK/AF queue causality event series
features.acceptance: Port bounded observability without P10-only Task_Stat assumptions; never conflate counter ages with physical receipt.
features.decision: Task/queue/transport/RX/AF status series are source-visible. Closed NWK occupancy/cause and physical host reception remain unknown.

features.name: R12 80-byte 2-slot CRC committed AUX journal
features.acceptance: CC2674P10 AUX address is not P7; prove ownership/power/reset retention or design safe alternative.
features.decision: No P10 AUX/MMIO journal port. Ownership/reset/power retention is unproven; ordinary RAM recorder is explicitly current-boot only.

features.name: R12 boundary sites9 NLME and10 MT-to-BDB; early pre-overwrite read
features.acceptance: P7 call graph + clock safety; no startup semantic change or blind MMIO.
features.decision: Source-visible ZDO/MT startup boundaries exist; R12 early pre-overwrite retained read and clock-domain semantics are not implemented.

features.name: R12 retained previous-boot event54 export and parser
features.acceptance: Only if retention proven; otherwise explicitly unavailable with protocol capability bit.
features.decision: Production previous-boot retention/event 54 is unavailable. Never infer retention from host-tested seal routines or RAM/noinit alone.

features.name: A1 restricted old-epoch transition, new attempt/epoch and event55 arm proof
features.acceptance: Reject corrupt/foreign epoch; event55 not proof network commissioned; no live use until retention proven.
features.decision: No A1 retained old-epoch/arm path without proven memory retention; legacy event 55 is not a commissioning witness.

features.name: A1 safe one-shot sequencing and no-startup-on-unarmed rule
features.acceptance: Prove full NIB+key+counter preservation pre/post flash; no automatic startup/reset.
features.decision: Two-phase single-unit approvals, protected app writer and separate deliberate NV5 operation replace P10 A1 arm sequencing. No automatic startup/reset.

features.name: R12 raw NVS physical vs logical indexing forensics
features.acceptance: Offline read-only forensic analysis, sanitized digest only, never public raw keys.
features.decision: Complete same-device flash/NV capture, independently verified copy, sector digests and original-state restoration plans are implemented and host tested. P10 raw-NVS logical forensics is not certified for P7 NV5.

features.name: Independent BASE/DIAG builds and no-secret public artifact policy
features.acceptance: Separate diagnostics/runtime profiles, hashes, no false hardware_qualified claim.
features.decision: Independent inherited BASE/DIAG comparisons plus integrated R1/R2 source/hashes exist. Public artifacts contain no installed network secrets; retention/physical qualification remain false.

unresolved: One unused P7U and backup-only network: physical BSL/bridge access, same-device backup read reliability, application rollback and NV restoration remain unproven.
Actual fitted UART/RF/oscillator/host-bridge mappings are not certified by LaunchPad compilation or dashboard metadata.
NV5 normal population/compaction/reopen has actual-driver host evidence; silicon power interruption, wear and full live security-table population remain unqualified.

The 32-bit broadcast hold mask with 96 association entries requires exact-SDK sleepy 0xFFFF tests at slots 31/32/63/95. Do not claim delivery from CAP192 sizes or widen a source array against the closed-library ABI.
Runtime RAM and persisted concentrator configuration must be checked after startup/restore; compiler defaults are insufficient.
NWK buffers 16/8/8/24, UART buffers 128/1080, conflict table 8, broadcast table 30 and data retries 4 remain deferred numerical tuning targets pending congestion/heap evidence.
P7 health/snapshot is a separate ABI from P10 SYS F0 v2 and T832D2; previous-boot/AUX retention is not implemented.
Closed TI NWK/APS/MAC/security libraries and ROM internals are outside source certification; source-route occupancy and hidden queue root cause are not exposed.

Network backup may omit per-device APS/TCLK security records. No same-network compatibility claim follows without private completeness audit and device rejoin/traffic evidence; re-pair remains explicit fallback.
The inherited F07 checkpoint rejects active/persisted NWK key mismatch; coordinated key rotation is not qualified.

local_provenance.source: read-only RDC git status and worktree list on ZephyrusG16
local_provenance.limits: Git status does not prove no untracked new firmware features in all other worktrees; no unpublished file contents copied to this public repo.

historical_scope: The immutable authority, P10 intent, evidence_path and original acceptance strings below are the G0 source audit, not current P7 completion flags.

software_evidence.qualification: Source/host work following that candidate requires a fresh native build; stage labels never qualify hardware.

current_capacity.note: Retain 12 source relays, broadcast 9/10, retries 2 and existing NWK buffers. No measured path-length or congestion evidence justifies changing these defaults. Source-route cache 192 and neighbors 64 address the established capacity gap.

acceptance_cases.RECOVERY: Repeat actual ROM BSL entry/exit and stock ZNP checks on this unit. Verify candidate/stock application CRCs, unchanged CCFG/IEEE, genuine stock rollback and BSL reentry.
acceptance_cases.BACKUP: Two independent complete same-device flash/NV reads must agree with ROM sector CRCs and hashes. Verify an off-device copy, interruption/resume and original-NV restore plan before destructive NV preparation.
acceptance_cases.NV: Use explicit backed-up five-sector NV5 preparation, then qualify initial boot, compaction and reopen. Stock-application rollback and original-NV restoration are separate operations.
acceptance_cases.HOST: Through the existing transport owner, verify ZNP/Herdsman startup, version, ping, AF/ZDO framing and unsolicited AREQ coexistence. Test the actual USB or TCP bridge and flow control; no second serial owner.
acceptance_cases.RF: Confirm fitted P7U revision, installed CCFG, UART, PA, clock and power identity. Prove bidirectional device traffic at the channels/powers in use; do not infer pins from a LaunchPad build.
acceptance_cases.CONCENTRATOR: After new formation and backup restore, read persisted NV 0x32/33/34/36 and live RAM. Require enable/cache/discovery/radius = 1/1/60/10, then observe many-to-one, route-record and routed delivery over air.
acceptance_cases.ROUTE: Start with representative multihop traffic, route records and rerouting; then exercise more than 12 active source routes. Keep the inherited 12-relay limit until observed paths justify change. The intended 60+ router network is a later load gate. AF status alone does not measure cache occupancy.
acceptance_cases.SLEEP32: Identify actual SDK association indices 30/31/32/33/63/64/95, rather than join count, then poll held broadcasts sent to 0xFFFF. Compare 0xFFFC/0xFFFD and unicast controls, rejoin and slot reuse. Failure blocks the sleepy-broadcast claim.
acceptance_cases.BURST: Run concurrent unicast, broadcast/group and ZDO traffic plus an SRSP storm. Measure queue backpressure, AF status, host latency and RX recovery. Compare current table/queue/retry values 9/10/2 before considering 30/10/4.
acceptance_cases.HEAP: Sample current free heap and observed failures after join, traffic and clean restart. Watch for a downward trend and AF delivery errors. Largest-block scans, fragmentation profiling and instrumentation for every internal queue are deferred unless measurements reveal a problem. Static linker headroom alone cannot pass.
acceptance_cases.HEALTH: Read v1/v2 diagnostics through the existing transport owner. Establish normal progress and exercise disconnect plus still-connected silent failures. Require bounded alarms/evidence and operator-controlled recovery; recorder evidence is current-boot only.
acceptance_cases.BIND: Exercise direct RODRET button-to-actuator bindings and coordinator bindings: add/read/delete, operate with host disconnected, survive restart/restore. Distinguish the local four-entry table from remote binding tables.
acceptance_cases.GROUP: Create/read/remove groups. Observe groupcast delivery at Tuya actuators/breakers and mixed routers under load; successful AF submission alone cannot pass.
acceptance_cases.OTA: Use actual Zigbee2MQTT OTA query/download/abort/resume on representative battery and router devices while normal traffic continues. Preserve bindings, security state and counters.
acceptance_cases.SLEEPREJOIN: Qualify RODRET and other battery devices with sleeping polls/reports, long sleep/rejoin, router-parent loss and coordinator restart. Prove commissioning and security relationships per device.
acceptance_cases.MIGRATE: Privately inventory coordinator backup plus device database and all available per-router/end-device APS/TCLK keys/counters. Identify missing records and explicit repair/re-pair fallback. Verify PAN, NWK key, IEEE and monotonic counters before RF use.
acceptance_cases.LOAD: After recovery and small trials, increase toward the intended 60+ routers/100+ devices. Before household cutover, require at least 24 h at the stable intended cohort with normal bursts and rejoin. No hang, uncommanded reset, counter rollback or unexplained persistent failure. OTA is conditional, not imposed.
acceptance_cases.POWER: Only after actual stock recovery, interrupt power during ordinary writes and compaction. Reopen without network wipe or key/counter rollback. Preserve the original private backup; host tests do not establish silicon retention.

notes.RECOVERY: Before writing: repeated BSL/stock startup and an independently verified compatible stock writer. Actual custom-to-stock rollback follows first trial, before migration.
notes.NV: Before NV erase: original capture/copy and explicit five-sector plan. After writing: first boot/restart. Compaction remains later persistence qualification.
notes.ROUTE: Trial: representative multihop traffic and rerouting, not all 192 entries. Intended 60+ router load is the later LOAD gate.
notes.HEAP: Use inexpensive current free-heap samples, AF errors and observed delivery. Largest-block scans, fragmentation profiling and a new allocator are deferred unless failure evidence calls for them.
notes.SLEEP32: Required only to claim 0xFFFF delivery to sleeping direct children above association slot 31. Determine whether actual household traffic needs it; do not silently claim it works.
notes.OTA: Required only before relying on OTA on this candidate. It is not a first-flash or basic coordination gate.
notes.POWER: Ordinary clean restart persistence is essential; deliberate cuts during writes/compaction are deferred on the only P7U until recovery is proven.
